notes: SDR commission paid on ACV of closed-won deals sourced from SDR meetings. Commission paid at deal close, not meeting. OTE assumes 100% quota achievement.
BDR differs from SDR in that BDR focuses on enterprise outbound. Higher OTE reflects larger deal ACV. Commission vests at deal close.
Base is 50% of OTE. Commission rates apply to ACV of new logo and expansion deals. Renewals flat rate 3%. Accelerators kick in above 100% of cumulative quarterly quota.
Same structure as Mid-Market AE with higher quota and higher accelerators. Additional $2000 SPIFF for deals > $200K ACV. Renewals at 3%.
Enterprise AEs carry named accounts. Commission rate slightly lower at low attainment to reflect larger deal sizes. Deals >$300K ACV: additional 1% bonus commission on full ACV. Renewals at 2.5%.
Top-tier individual contributor. Handles strategic accounts (>1000 employee prospects). Additional President's Club eligibility at 140%+ annual attainment (trip + $10K cash).
Sales Manager OTE includes team override: 1.5% of all team-closed ACV up to 100% team quota; 3% of all team ACV above 100% team quota. No individual deal commission.
Director override: 0.75% of all team-closed ACV up to 100%; 2% above 100%. Eligible for President's Club at 130%+ team attainment.
VP commission tied to company-wide ARR target. 5% of base per 10% above 100% company attainment. Maximum VP bonus 35% of base. Equity refreshed at 150%+ company attainment.
